cards.public_summary: Odell Beckham Jr. caught a back-end-zone touchdown from Jameis Winston and had a red-zone reception from Jaxson Dart, Pat Leonard reported.
cards.evidence:
Some big Giants pass plays today in 11 on 11 situation period:

Isaiah Hodgins with an awesome one-handed grab deep down the sideline from Brandon Allen

Odell Beckham Jr. with a TD catch in the back of the end zone from Jameis Winston on a similar route and throw to the one in the Miami game

Jaxson Dart had some red zone period success to Malik Nabers, Darnell Mooney, Chris Manhertz, OBJ

Malik Nabers looked very good running today and even made a leaping catch on the sideline. But he also didn’t finish the practice

He walked inside with the Giants’ return to play coordinator as the situation period began
cards.commentary: The reported red-zone catches are a modest positive for Beckham’s scoring-use outlook, but they were isolated practice plays and do not establish a regular role or target volume.
cards.author: Pat Leonard
cards.model_original_commentary: The reported red-zone catches are a modest positive for Beckham’s scoring-use outlook, but they were isolated practice plays and do not establish a regular role or target volume.
draft_limitations: Based on a single practice report.
The evidence does not establish first-team status, snap share, targets, or a sustained red-zone role.

cards.public_summary: Jaxson Dart had multiple deep completions and accounted for five touchdowns in the Giants’ goal-line work, according to Art Stapleton.
cards.evidence:
Jaxson Dart connected on a couple big pass plays in live team periods today at Giants

OBJ 35-yarder on which Beckham went up and got it inside 5. Was not touched, so OBJ crawled final 3 yards to break goal line for TD

Dart offscript, chased by Abdul Carter in own EZ, fired deep to Darnell Mooney with great catch between 2 defenders for 40+

Later in practice, Jaxson Dart continued his strong play in goal line period.

Eight plays, Dart threw 4 TD passes (Nabers, Fields, Manhertz, OBJ) and ran for another TD

Another good day for Giants QB1
cards.commentary: Stapleton’s description of Dart as Giants QB1 and his productive goal-line session support short-term starting-QB momentum, but this is one practice report without workload or season-long role certainty.
cards.author: Art Stapleton
